## Data cleaning
```{r}
# outcome is whether a vaccine was received
data = process_data(filename = 'child_politics_covariates_05012025.csv.zip', 
                             time_var = 'time_to_vax', 
                             filter_yr = 1988, 
                             filter_outcome_time= 3+11/12, # must have been vaccinated for an on time second dose
                             filter_engage_time = 1,
                             remove_after_4 = FALSE)
data$indic = as.numeric(data$indic)*100
data$year_num = as.numeric(data$year_num)
```

Plot the disparity in time to delay over time
```{r}
nrow(data)
sum(data$indic/100)
plot_year_disparity(data, outcome = 'indic', 
                    party_baseline = "D", 
                    title = "", 
                    hist_title = "Number of Observations per Year",
                    ylab = "Estimated MMR Vaccination Gap\n(Percentage Points)",
                    line_color = "darkslategray4",
                    hist_color = "darkslategray4",
                    labFalse = "Unvaccinated",
                    labTrue = "Vaccinated",)
ggsave(
  '~/afc-claire/code/figures/mmr_uptake.png',
  width = 7,
  height = 5)
```

Run the interaction model on indicator of delay

```{r}
model_table = interaction_model(data, party_reference = 'D', ref_year = 1988, outcome = 'indic', state_FE = FALSE, x = TRUE)

rownames(model_table) <- NULL
# Generate LaTeX table with kable
latex_out <- kable(model_table, 
      format = "latex", 
      caption = "Delay", 
      booktabs = TRUE,  # For cleaner lines
      align = c("l"),
      escape = FALSE)  # Left-align the first column and right-align others
cat(latex_out)
```
